title: Personal Training Packages: the not-yet-consumed session count at refund
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how the number of sessions not yet consumed on a package is counted at the moment a refund is being recorded.

## Rule
The not-yet-consumed session count is the tier's own granted session count plus every bonus session credited to the package, less every session already consumed by a session redemption or by a late cancellation logged on the package, floored at zero so the count is never negative.

## Points of judgement
The granted total that forms the starting point is the tier's own session count together with the running total of every bonus session ever credited to that same package; sessions consumed are then subtracted, counting both a session actually attended and a session forfeited to a late cancellation equally as consumed, since both remove a session from what remains. Where the sessions consumed would otherwise exceed the granted total -- for example after the tier's own weekly fair-use pattern on an unlimited package, or after a run of forfeitures -- the count is held at zero rather than allowed to go negative.

## Prerequisite
a bonus session owed under the package's loyalty entitlement, wherever one is owed and not yet credited, must be credited before a refund is recorded on the package. Where it is unmet, the not-yet-consumed session count used for the refund does not yet reflect that bonus session, and the refund is not recorded against the package until it is credited.
